prompt:
Create ONE portrait-format reference illustration containing exactly ONE
full-body adult man in a strict LEFT SIDE PROFILE. The supplied reference
portrait is the identity and graphic-style source for this same adult man.
Show his anatomical left side with his nose pointing toward image-left.
The entire body must be viewed SIDE-ON at 90 degrees to the frontal view:
head, shoulders, ribcage, torso, pelvis, knees and both feet all share the
same lateral orientation. This is NOT a three-quarter body with only its
head turned sideways. Use an eye-level orthographic-like, low-distortion
side presentation, camera perpendicular to the body's left side.

The near and far shoulders should align in side projection; the torso and
jacket read as a narrow lateral silhouette, not a broad frontal chest.
Do not display the two front lapels and broad shirt opening as if facing
the viewer. Keep natural anatomy: the far arm and leg may be substantially
occluded by the near ones in a genuine side view, not removed or amputated.
Both shoes point toward image-left, not outward in a front-view stance.
Neutral standing comparison pose, arms relaxed beside the body, empty hands,
feet comfortably grounded, shoulders relaxed, subdued tired expression.
Full body visible from hair tips to shoe soles, with clear margin above and
below; no cropping, extra figure, inset, grid or turnaround row.

Preserve the reference man's angular adult face, jaw and nose structure,
tired eyes and under-eye shadows, dark-brown short tousled hair with irregular
locks, and short beard/stubble. Keep his apparent adult age and natural
proportions without exact age, numerical height, ethnicity or a newly
specified iris colour. No beautification, rejuvenation, smooth fashion-model
face, newly groomed hairstyle or extra muscular bulk.

Preserve the approved complete-body clothing look described here: anthracite
suit jacket and matching trousers, light-grey shirt with open collar and no
tie, restrained dark belt at the waist, simple matte-black dress shoes.
Maintain a natural, unexaggerated adult silhouette, ordinary fabric folds
and the same restrained suit cut. Keep the jacket on and open as in the
portrait, while showing it from its true side. Do not substitute an ivory
shirt, green suit, sneakers, boots, trench coat or decorative accessories.

Use the reference's realistic-proportion semi-anime drawn language: fine
visible dark contours, restrained painterly cel facets and natural volumes,
not a photograph, chibi or plastic 3D render. Keep a subtle muted olive/
charcoal, Matrix-influenced sensibility in the painted shadows without
recolouring the anthracite suit or washing skin uniformly green. Plain
neutral-grey, lightly textured comparison background, soft diffuse even
illumination, readable face, beard, jacket and trousers, restrained small
grounding shadow. Do not copy the portrait's dramatic nocturnal background,
amber rim light, doorway pose or deep black shadows. No scene, apartment,
cats, props, narrative action, labels, text, border or watermark.
